visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a wide shot of a circular, multi-tiered display stand in a brightly lit retail store. The stand is densely packed with Stitch and Angel plush toys of various sizes. A large, stylized Stitch figure is the centerpiece. The background shows shelves filled with more blue and pink merchandise under bright pink and white lights. (2) The camera transitions to close-up shots of various merchandise. This includes blue water bottles with Stitch designs, pink skincare tubes featuring Angel, and blue pens. The items are arranged neatly on shelves with price tags visible. The lighting remains bright and consistent. (3) The focus shifts to a dedicated section dominated by pink plush toys. Numerous soft, pink Angel plushies of different sizes are stacked together. Some carry small yellow accessories. The scene is visually warm and cluttered with soft textures. (4) A quick montage shows blind box packaging in yellow and blue boxes, stacked vertically. Next, home goods like tote bags, drinking glasses, and storage containers in pastel blues and pinks are shown. The items feature various character illustrations. (5) A hand with a white smartwatch enters the frame and picks up a medium-sized blue Stitch plush. The hand demonstrates the plush's magnetic feature by attaching its hands to a pink metal structure. The plush hangs from the metal frame. (6) The camera shows a flat-lay of several items: a large Stitch plush, a pink Angel plush, a coloring book, and small boxed magnets. The video concludes with a wide panning shot of the store's interior, showing a customer browsing among the vast array of character-themed products.
